policy_text: The city will extend late-night transit service for six months and review ridership, accessibility, worker safety, and operating cost each month.
personality_seed: Three night-shift hospital workers: one practical and cost-conscious, one cautious about personal safety, and one wheelchair user focused on accessible journeys. They are riders, not officials.
